security_audit.summary: The large static finding count is mostly false positives from CSS, Markdown links, JavaScript template literals, and design prose. Confirmed issues are limited to remote CDN/font loading, subprocess and package-bootstrap helpers, environment forwarding during bootstrap, dynamic imports, and innerHTML-based design picker rendering. I also found an unpinned @latest fallback in the dependency bootstrap path.

remediation.issue: Remote script and font loading in templates and showcases
remediation.suggestion: Vendor GSAP and fonts locally where possible, or document required network access and use integrity checks for externally hosted scripts.

remediation.issue: Package bootstrap can install mutable dependency specs
remediation.suggestion: Remove the @latest fallback, require immutable package versions, and keep dependency bootstrap opt-in with clear warnings.

remediation.issue: Design picker renders generated HTML with innerHTML
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize preview_html and prompt-derived strings, or build DOM nodes instead of concatenating raw HTML. Reject scripts, event handlers, and javascript URLs before rendering.

remediation.issue: Audio extraction runs ffmpeg and writes a user-selected output path
remediation.suggestion: Validate input and output paths, keep default outputs inside the workspace, and document that ffmpeg processes untrusted media.

content.value_statement: Video compositions often drift into generic web layouts or inconsistent brand choices. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through HyperFrames design specs, presets, palettes, typography, narration, and beat planning.
actual_capabilities: Routes creative tasks to focused references for house style, composition, typography, narration, and beat planning.
Explains how to read frame.md, design.md, and preset FRAME.md files as brand source material.
Provides ready-made frame presets with showcase HTML and caption skins.
Includes a design picker template for palettes, type pairings, layouts, density, depth, and easing.
Offers helper scripts for contrast reports and audio band extraction.
limitations: It is not the motion-pattern skill; detailed animation blueprints belong in hyperframes-animation.
Some workflows depend on local scripts, ffmpeg, browser capture tooling, or optional npm packages.
HTML previews may load external CDNs and Google Fonts unless assets are vendored locally.
It does not replace project-specific design approval or accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Shape a Video Brand System
use_cases.description: Translate a product brief into frame-scale colors, typography, layout rhythm, and composition rules.

use_cases.title: Choose a Frame Preset
use_cases.description: Compare bundled visual directions and adopt a preset as a starting point for a HyperFrames project.

use_cases.title: Prepare Accessible Motion Assets
use_cases.description: Use the helper references and scripts to plan contrast, audio-reactive data, captions, and render-friendly composition structure.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Starting Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-creative to suggest three visual directions for this product video. Explain the palette, typography, composition density, and narration tone for each direction.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Frame Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the project frame.md or design.md, then propose a HyperFrames composition plan that preserves the exact brand colors, fonts, weights, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Scene Beat Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a beat-by-beat creative plan for a 30 second HyperFrames video. Include visual hierarchy, caption style, pacing, and transitions to request from hyperframes-animation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Finished Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames composition against the design spec. Identify mismatched colors, weak type choices, poor density, contrast concerns, and places where narration or beat structure should change.

output_examples.input: A product launch video needs a premium but readable visual direction.
output_examples.output: A concise creative brief with one primary palette, a display and body type pairing, scene density guidance, and narration tone notes.

output_examples.input: A team wants to choose between bundled frame presets.
output: A short comparison of suitable presets.
A recommendation with tradeoffs for mood, readability, and production speed.
A checklist for adapting the preset into a project frame spec.

output_examples.input: A composition feels too much like a web page.
output_examples.output: A set of frame-specific revisions covering scale, foreground metadata, motion timing, caption treatment, and visual density.

best_practices: Read the project frame.md or design.md before changing colors, typography, or composition rules.
Use the house style and video composition references for non-trivial work before writing HTML.
Vendor remote assets or document required network access when using CDNs and hosted fonts.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this skill as a replacement for hyperframes-animation when detailed motion rules are needed.
Do not copy a preset without adapting its tokens, narration, and density to the actual product.
Do not inject arbitrary preview HTML into the design picker without sanitizing scripts, event handlers, and unsafe URLs.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides visual direction for HyperFrames videos, including specs, presets, typography, palettes, captions, narration, and beat planning.

faq.question: Does it generate final animation code?
faq.answer: It focuses on creative direction. Detailed animation patterns and scene blueprints should use hyperframes-animation.

faq.question: Can it use an existing brand system?
faq.answer: Yes. It prioritizes frame.md, design.md, or DESIGN.md and treats their frontmatter tokens as brand truth.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made styles?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes several frame presets with FRAME.md templates, showcase HTML, and caption skins.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Some preview HTML loads CDNs or Google Fonts. Teams can reduce this by vendoring scripts and fonts locally.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review external asset loading, generated preview HTML, optional package bootstrap behavior, contrast, and any project-specific brand constraints.
